description: The AI system should have a documented business or technical owner.
recommendation: Assign and document an accountable AI system owner.

description: The AI system should have a clear documented use case and business purpose.
recommendation: Document the AI use case, intended users, and business purpose.

description: The AI system should define when humans review, approve, or override AI outputs.
recommendation: Define human review requirements for high-risk AI outputs or decisions.

description: The AI system should document whether sensitive data is used, processed, stored, or restricted.
recommendation: Document data handling rules and prevent unnecessary sensitive data exposure.

description: The AI system should include safeguards against prompt injection and jailbreak attempts.
recommendation: Add prompt injection detection, input validation, and system prompt protection.

description: The AI system should define how outputs are reviewed, validated, or quality checked.
recommendation: Define validation steps for AI outputs, especially for high-impact use cases.

description: The AI system should define how usage, errors, risky prompts, or security events are logged.
recommendation: Add logging and monitoring for AI usage, risky prompts, and system errors.

description: The AI system should include a documented plan for responding to identified risks.
recommendation: Document how AI risks will be mitigated, accepted, transferred, or escalated.

description: The AI system should define who can access, configure, or administer the system.
recommendation: Define role-based access control and apply least privilege.

control_name: User Disclosure or Usage Notice Provided
description: Users should be informed when they are interacting with or relying on an AI system.
recommendation: Provide users with a clear AI usage notice or disclosure.
